title: Reinforced Axe
body:
"A powerful blacksteel axe, reinforced with Adurite found deep below the magma caves."

Description

The Reinforced Axe, available exclusively at The Oak Depot, commands a price tag of $44,000. It is renowned as the best purchasable axe in the game.

Appearance

Refined from the finest materials, the Reinforced Axe stands tall, crafted from Blacksteel—a material yet to be introduced—and Adurite.

Trivia

  • The Reinforced Axe, alongside its companions in the reinforced tool set, was introduced as part of the highly anticipated Progression Update
  • When initially introduced, its original price was an exorbitant $266,000
  • When initially introduced, it delivered 0.625 damage
